# Optional visual libraries

These local assets are pinned snapshots of two user-requested MIT-licensed browser projects:

- `liquid-glass-js/` from `dashersw/liquid-glass-js` at commit `78cb6ccb0b9987bb60a88b14ccbd13a9e6e8ab2a`
- `liquid-logo/` from `collidingScopes/liquid-logo` at commit `c733c38a043009b873cb9a6062c0defa9c70ee7d`

The desktop shell only loads the glass stylesheet as a progressive enhancement. The WebGL renderers remain isolated under their own folders for future branding or companion experiments; they are not on the governed execution path and are not required for startup, keyboard access, reduced-motion behavior, or forced-colors support.
